messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: Acme Finance sent a security intake during onboarding. They want DPA answers + a brief KMS/key-provenance note and a one-page dataflow. Deadline = EOD Thursday.
support-bot: uploaded attachment acme_security_questionnaire_v2.pdf (shared)
olivia_pm: thanks. renewal meeting is in 8 business days so CS wants this turned around quickly.
maria_cs: priority: DPA responses, confirm rotation/audit logs, state whether BYOK is available, and a redacted example of key provenance. Also nonprod access controls question.
sanjay_security: I can write the attestation. Quick question: do we need to state process for Dedicated vs Hosted? better to keep it high level unless they request specifics.
liam_eng: agree. here's a short snippet we can include for Hosted vs Dedicated:
```
Hosted: Keys are managed by Redwood with HSM-backed storage; per-tenant separation enforced.
Dedicated/Private: Customers may provision BYOK; we provide integration guidance and validation checks.
```
maria_cs: include rotation cadence and logs too — they asked about rotation frequency and evidence of audits.
sanjay_security: draft line: "Keys are rotated annually or upon critical events; rotation and key usage are logged and retained in audit logs per our retention policy." good?
olivia_pm: good. Also they want a one-page dataflow diagram PDF — can design a redacted diagram. @sales_ops FYI, if they push BYOK request, timeline/resource note?
sales_ops: if BYOK requested for Hosted -> we need infra involvement; estimate 2-3 weeks for approvals + validation. For Dedicated it's standard to provide BYOK during setup.
maria_cs: ok I'll prep the questionnaire answers with those lines. Sanjay, can you drop the attestation paragraph here? two short paragraphs + template for key provenance (redacted).
sanjay_security: pasted draft below:
---
We confirm that Redwood Inference encrypts customer data at rest using industry-standard key management practices. For Hosted deployments, keys are managed by Redwood and stored in HSM-backed services with tenant separation. For Dedicated and Private deployments, customers may bring their own keys (BYOK) and we provide integration guidance.

Keys are rotated on an annual cadence or immediately after any suspected compromise. All rotation and key-access events are recorded in audit logs and retained according to our retention policy. We can provide redacted key provenance samples upon request.
---
liam_eng: adding a redacted example (replace real IDs with Xs):
```
KeyAlias: redwood-acme-2024
KmsKeyId: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx (redacted)
Created: 2023-06-12
Rotated: 2024-06-15
RotationPolicy: annual
```
maria_cs: perfect. I'll attach the attestation + the redacted provenance + a one-page PNG dataflow (redacted). Uploading now.
support-bot: uploaded files: acme_attestation.txt, acme_key_provenance_redacted.txt, acme_dataflow_onepager.png
olivia_pm: nice. Maria, after you post answers, can you capture feedback from Acme about whether this met their requests? want to track in onboarding checklist.
maria_cs: will do. tagging follow-up: if they request IP allowlist or VPC peering we'll escalate to infra and sales.
sales_ops: noted. I'll prepare a quick note for pricing/seq on BYOK requests.
maria_cs: thanks team :thumbsup: — posting answers now and will update thread when Acme responds.
